title: warden commands have no --help; report prints a misleading error instead
body:
What happened: asking for help does not work. `warden report --help` prints "warden: --kind must be bug or enhancement". `warden start --help` prints "warden: unknown option --help". Neither lists the options. The agent had to guess; a first `warden start` with the title as the id failed with "task id ... does not match ^PG-\d{3}$".
Expected: `--help` on any command prints usage (arguments, options, an example), and exits 0.
Steps: run `warden report --help`, then `warden start --help`.
Evidence: the two messages above.
note: Fixed. warden --help and warden <command> --help print usage.
